understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level, avoiding spike tiles and continuing until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT change the horizontal position, after which gravity automatically carries the player until landing or reaching the goal. Gravity direction determines whether the player falls toward smaller or larger y values. CLICK removes a targeted breakable tile without moving the player, while landing on spikes ends the attempt. UNDO can revert the previous action. Passage columns should be used to access new sections, and clicks should open blocked gravity paths.
